integrityNotes: No tested threshold pair changed the #1 driver, but launch/spin cutoffs create non-trivial score and Top-10 movement from tiny numeric changes.
Head ranking is invariant to AoA at -4, 0, and +4 degrees when all other fitting inputs are held constant. AoA still affects the separate loft/configuration layer.
